essencial.opcao.zoom_nivel.dica: How many times closer when you press the zoom key. The mouse wheel changes it afterwards.
essencial.opcao.zoom_rolagem.dica: While zooming, the mouse wheel zooms in and out instead of changing the held item.
essencial.opcao.zoom_alternar.dica: On: one press turns zoom on, another turns it off. Off: zoom lasts while the key is held.
essencial.opcao.hud.dica: Shows FPS, coordinates, facing and ping in a corner of the screen.
essencial.opcao.amigos.dica: Connects to the friends server in config/essencial.toml for a friends list, messages and invites.
On: your friends see which server you are playing on. Off: they only see "Playing online".
essencial.opcao.amigos_avisos.dica: Shows a notice in a corner when a message, invite or friend request arrives.
